summary: Candidate complementary sources for the New Brunswick, NJ simulation. The opened sources provide national or multi-state reference data and survey instruments, not additional locally representative patient-experience estimates for RWJUH, Saint Peter’s, or Middlesex County. HCAHPS is already acquired in the workspace; AHRQ’s supplemental items and reference databases may add communication and patient-goal dimensions. Treat all findings as candidates pending independent verification and acquisition.

sources.title: CAHPS Data Tools
sources.publisher: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
sources.geography: Aggregated participating survey-user results; geographic and product-type filters vary by database. Not specific to Middlesex County or either named hospital.
sources.period: Health Plan Survey results since 2019; Child Hospital results for 2023–2024; HCBS results for 2023–2024; Clinician & Group results for 2018–2019.
sources.grain: Aggregated score by survey database, survey year, measure/item, and available geography or product type; dashboard download depends on selected filters.
observed_facts: The public tool reports aggregated results and offers an Excel download for the selected visualization.
Top-box results represent the percentage of respondents selecting the most positive response; charts also show response-category distributions.

The listed databases and periods differ: Child Hospital data cover 2023–2024, HCBS data cover 2023–2024, and Clinician & Group data cover 2018–2019; AHRQ suspended new Clinician & Group submissions in 2021.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Select one database relevant to the simulation population, choose a specific year and measure/item, inspect available geography filters, and use the on-page Download Data control. Save the selected filters and dashboard context with the downloaded workbook; do not combine respondent counts across questions.
limitations: These are aggregated comparison inputs, not local hospital or county estimates.
Database participants are a subset of survey users; coverage varies by program and period.
The dashboard page was inspected, but a specific filtered workbook or direct downloadable file was not acquired or verified.
Not an instrument for inferring actual patients’ goals, trust, or individual communication needs.

sources.title: CAHPS Adult Hospital Survey
sources.publisher: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ), describing the CMS-administered HCAHPS survey
sources.geography: National inpatient adult survey; CMS publicly reports hospital results. The source describes national and some state/community comparisons.
sources.period: Current measure set effective January 1, 2025; CMS public results are updated quarterly. Historical periods depend on the selected CMS release.
sources.grain: Hospital-level survey measures; this page describes instrument scope and measures rather than providing a data file.
observed_facts: AHRQ describes the adult survey as measuring experiences of people age 18 and older receiving inpatient care.
The effective-2025 measures include communication, responsiveness, medication communication, discharge information, symptom information, global rating, and recommendation measures.
AHRQ identifies supplemental items about health literacy and interpreter-service experience. The page states that the survey, methodology, and results are in the public domain.
sources.retrieval_next_step: For a bounded extension beyond the already acquired HCAHPS source, retrieve the official supplemental health-literacy and interpreter-services items from the linked AHRQ materials, record instrument version and item wording in paraphrase, and link only to public hospital aggregate results already in the workspace. Verify applicable reuse terms for the linked CMS materials before redistribution.
limitations: The named hospitals and CCNs are not independently checked here; the CMS source already held in the workspace is the appropriate place to confirm facility-level values.
The 2025 measure set and administration changes may not be comparable without a version-aware crosswalk to older periods.
The page describes survey measures and links to materials; this response did not acquire a new CMS hospital dataset.

sources.title: Measures, Data, and Funding for Shared Decision Making Research
sources.publisher: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
sources.geography: United States; household survey respondents, not local hospital patients.
sources.period: MEPS shared-decision-making item collected annually since 2002, according to AHRQ. HINTS is another cited national source; the page describes its survey cadence and directs users to its data files.
sources.grain: MEPS respondent record in Full Year Consolidated Files; shared-decision-making item DECIDE42. HINTS respondent record includes InvolvedDecisions.
useful_fields: DECIDE42: frequency a medical professional at the respondent’s usual source of care asks them to help decide between treatments
InvolvedDecisions: frequency health professionals involved the respondent in decisions as much as wanted
observed_facts: AHRQ identifies DECIDE42 in MEPS Full Year Consolidated Files and says the item has been collected annually since 2002.
AHRQ identifies HINTS item InvolvedDecisions and describes it as asking about involvement in healthcare decisions during the prior 12 months.
AHRQ says CAHPS supplemental shared-decision items focus on specific decisions such as starting or stopping medication and discussing a procedure.
sources.retrieval_next_step: For a single bounded national benchmark, select one named MEPS Full Year Consolidated File year from the official download page, retrieve its accompanying codebook, and extract DECIDE42 with survey weights and missing-value codes preserved. Record the year, file/version, variable definition, and survey population; do not present weighted national results as local estimates.
limitations: MEPS and HINTS are national survey benchmarks and do not identify experiences at RWJUH, Saint Peter’s, or in Middlesex County.
The MEPS direct URL is a verified official download landing page, not a verified direct file URL for a particular year.
AHRQ’s shared-decision page was inspected; the linked MEPS file itself and its current redistribution terms were not inspected or acquired.
Responses describe reported experience, not objective quality or a patient-specific clinical preference.

missing_inputs: No newly discovered, inspected source here provides a verified local Middlesex County or facility-specific measure of patient goals, trust, or communication beyond the already acquired CMS HCAHPS and RWJUH CHNA sources.

The requested bounded ten-theme extraction from the RWJUH CHNA is outside this complementary-source lookup and remains to be collected from the report with page locators and participant/context scope.
No direct downloadable file for a selected AHRQ database filter or MEPS year was acquired in this discovery task.
simulation_use: Use AHRQ CAHPS database aggregates or MEPS DECIDE42 only as explicitly labeled external benchmarks for scenario calibration. Use the adult HCAHPS instrument’s communication, health literacy, and interpreter-service dimensions to shape evidence-linked communication criteria. Keep patient goals and trust as scenario concerns or synthetic inputs unless directly supported by local qualitative evidence; do not infer demographic traits or clinician personalities. Preserve source, survey version, population, period, measure, and access status for each record.
limitations: This is discovery, not dataset acquisition; no records, workbooks, or survey microdata were downloaded.
Search scope was limited to two searches and four primary-source page opens.
AHRQ pages indicate public query/download behavior and HCAHPS public-domain status, but redistribution rights for all linked data products were not separately verified.
All source findings are candidate research requiring independent source-scope, rights, and domain-owner applicability review.
